messages:
jonathan: Hey benefits team 1 quick one: I'm on Redwood PPO Gold, currently visiting family in AZ for 6 weeks. My PCP back home (OR) sent a referral for a cardiology consult to Desert Heart in Phoenix, but Acme portal says the specialist is OON for my temporary address. Appointment is next Tuesday. Anyone handled an out-of-area referral like this without a long billing fight?

sam_people_ops: Short answer: sometimes you can get a single-case agreement or a referral override, especially for urgent/soon appointments. Did the PCP include an in-network referral code and the reason for urgent consult?

jonathan: Referral doc mentions "arrhythmia evaluation" and requests echo + holter. PCP put referral code 99244 and indicated urgency. I have the PDF.

drIA-hr: If it's urgent, we can escalate to broker for a manual exception. Two things to prepare: 1) copy of referral + clinical note, 2) the specialist's billing NPI and TIN. Often the portal flags OON because network contracts are regional.

broker-julia: I'll open a network exception with Acme. Please DM me the referral PDF and the clinic billing details. Also let me know if you expect inpatient services (single-case agreements differ).

jonathan: DMed the referral and Desert Heart billing NPI 555555111. They're outpatient only.

clinic-admin: Hi Jonathan 1 Desert Heart here. We can mark the visit as "pre-authorized pending insurer confirmation" and accept in-network rates if Acme issues written approval. If the insurer denies, we ask for a deposit then reverse any balance after adjudication.

sam_people_ops: Noted. Broker-Julia, request in writing that Acme confirm eligibility and that claims will be processed in-network for the scheduled date pending exception. That written confirmation is key to avoid patient balance risk.

broker-julia: Opening case ACME-SCA-202607-8812: requesting single-case agreement / referral override for Jonathan (member last4 7782). Submitted referral and clinic W-9. Requested written confirmation to cover services on 2026-07-20.

insurance-bot: ACME-SCA-202607-8812 created. Status: received by network ops. Estimated review 3 business days.

jonathan: Fingers crossed 1 I can't wait 3 days, need to keep the appointment. Clinic says they'll hold slot for 48 hours. Any temporary workaround?

sam_people_ops: If Acme can do an eligibility verification call, clinic can confirm coverage at check-in. But that's not binding for claims. Ask clinic to take photo of any provider call ID and save written notes. Also request the clinic to bill under the in-network rendering NPI if that matches a contracted provider.

broker-julia: Update: Acme network ops requested an MD-to-MD statement clarifying medical necessity due to arrhythmia symptoms. I've notified Jonathan's PCP and clinic. Also asked Acme for expedited review given near-term appt.

jonathan: PCP emailed a supplemental note just now. Julia, did you get it?

broker-julia: Got it, uploaded to ACME-SCA-202607-8812. Also requested written conditional approval: "if pre-auth and referral received, claims to be processed as in-network".

insurance-bot: ACME-SCA-202607-8812 updated: network ops requested documentation; expedited flag applied.

clinic-admin: We received a call from Acme verifying eligibility verbally; they said they see a pending exception but need the MD note for approval. Clinic will proceed with appointment and mark service as pre-auth pending.

sam_people_ops: Internal note for tracker: "Out-of-area cardiology consult; broker requested single-case agreement; MD-to-MD note uploaded; clinic to hold appointment and flag as pre-auth pending."

insurance-bot: ACME-SCA-202607-8812 closed: exception approved; services on 2026-07-20 authorized at in-network rates. Written confirmation sent to member and provider. Case resolved.

jonathan: Amazing, thanks everyone. Clinic confirmed they received the written approval and will bill as in-network. Closing loop. :tada:
